Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. Australia players stride out to the middle. Followed by Takudzwanashe Kaitano and Tadiwanashe Marumani who walk out to open for Zimbabwe. It will be Mitchell Starc to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then. Zimbabwe bowlers have certainly done their job really well. The onus is now on their batters to chase this below-par target and take a consolation win from the series as well as the Super League points. Australia though do have a capable bowling line-up who could well defend 141 if they make the most of the conditions on offer. It will be a fiesty chase. Do join us for the second essay in a short while.

Zimbabwe did bring A-game to this final encounter of the series. This is the first time Regis Chakabva won the toss in this series and the decision to bowl first has done wonders for the visitors. It were the two pacers Richard Ngarava and Victor Nyauchi who set the tone with their brilliant exhibition with the new ball. They kept asking the right questions and took three wickets inside Powerplay 1. This is the first time since 2013 that Australia lost three wickets inside the first Powerplay at home. It was then Brad Evans who came into the attack and took two wickets in quick succession to make it worse for the opposition. Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza did take some beating from Maxwell and Warner although not for long as Ryan Burl came to their rescue.

David Warner was the shining light on a dull Australian scoreboard. It though did not end well for Warner as he slipped out on 96 and could not get his ton. Glenn Maxwell was the only other batter who got into double-digits. This certainly sums up the performance of the hosts. They just could not build stands in the middle and have bundled out for just 141 runs here.

There was some glimmer of hope for the Aussie when Warner and Maxwell were brewing a partnership. Little did they know what the Zimbabwe skipper had in store for them. He gets on Ryan Burl into the attack and that takes the game away from the hosts. Ryan Burl bags a fifer in just three overs and he walks back off the field with a smille on his face and the match ball in his hand.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Take a bow, Ryan Burl. A five-wicket haul in just 3 overs. He goes outside off with a hint of turn, Josh Hazlewood leans forward to defend it but misses. A loud appeal but the finger stays down. Ryan Burl is confident and the skipper takes it upstairs. Ultra Edge shows a slight spike and Australia are skittled out in just 31 overs for a mere 141!
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: This one lands fuller and on off, Adam Zampa taps it to point for one.
Fuller and outside leg, Josh Hazlewood looks to play at it but misses. The keeper misses it as well as the batters collect three runs. Its a wide as well.
Fuller and on off, defended.

OUT! TIMBER! Ryan Burl is on a fire. He picks his fourth wicket in his third over and has just conceded five runs. Coming to the delivery, this is fuller and on middle, Mitchell Starc looks to defend it but misses and the ball knocks over the middle pole. Australia lose their 9th wicket. Josh Hazlewood is the final man in.
Another dot as this is played at covers.
Fuller and on off, defended.
Fuller again, on middle, Adam Zampa flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.

Make it four dots. Fuller and outside off with a hint of turn away, Zampa looks to defend it out but misses. Regis Chakabva appeals for a caught behind but the umpire shows no interest. Regis Chakabva takes the review. The replays shows that there is huge gap between bat and ball. The on-field decision stands.
Bowls it down the leg side, Adam Zampa flicks it to square leg. Three dots now.
Outside off this time, this is defended to short covers.
Flatter and down the middle, Adam Zampa defends it back towards the bowler.
Fuller and outside off, Mitchell Starc eases it to point for one.
Adam Zampa walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! David Warner's valiant innings comes to an end. He was eyeing to get his ton in some fine fashion but has to trudge back to the pavilion. It is full and outside off. David Warner gets down on one knee and slogs it to deep mid-wicket. He does not middle it. Sean Williams charges in from the deep, slides in, he fails to gather the ball first time but takes a one-hander on the rebound. Ryan Burl adds another wicket into his kitty.
Commentary.Howout: c Brad Evans b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball, on off. Warner pulls it to deep square leg. The batters get two.
Full, on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller, on the stumps. Warner fends it away.
On off, blocked out.
TWO WIDES! Floated, full, down leg. Starc looks to sweep it away but misses. The keeper misses it as well. The batters sneak a single.
On off, blocked out.
Four dots on the trot to end the over! This is full, sliding into the pads. Warner blocks it back to the bowler.
Yorker length, on off. Warner digs it out to safety.
Fuller, on off, touch quicker. Warner gets forward and defends it out.
A dot now! Much straighter and at the stumps. Warner blocks it out.
Starc is off the mark! Short agian. Starc punches it to deep point for a single.
Too short, outside off. Warner punches it to point for a single.
Mitchell Starc is the next batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ryan Burl gets his second wicket of the over. A master stroke from the skipper. The decision to keep the spin on has done wonders here. It is a juicy full toss, angled down leg. Agar just flicks it straight to short mid-wicket. Wesley Madhevere takes a dolly. Australia are seven down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Wesley Madhevere b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on off, Agar blocks it to square leg.
Ashton Agar walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Ryan Burl comes into the attack and breaks a crucial stand here. It is tossed up, around off. It grips and turns away. Glenn Maxwell looks to slog it away but does so against the turn. The ball catches the leading edge and flies high in the air to the left of the bowler. Ryan Burl call for it, goes under it, settles and takes a clean catch.
Outside off, driven to covers.
A full toss, on off, Maxwell whips it to short mid-wicket.
Floated and full, outside off, slower through the air. Warner looks to drive it away but gets an inside edge. The ball goes past the off pole towards fine leg. One taken.
Ryan Burl comes into the attack.

Full, on middle and leg. Maxwell tucks it to short mid-wicket. 6 runs off the over this time. David Warner and Glenn Maxwell are finding it real easy to score against the spinners. Will they capitalize on this opportunity?
Fuller, on off, Warner eases it to mid on for one.
Tossed up, full and on off. Warner defends it to the right of the bowler.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! David Warner is feasting on the spinners here. It is short, outside off. Warner hangs back and cuts it past the diving fielder at point. It races away.
Shorter, outside off. Maxwell goes back and cuts it to deep point for one.
Fuller, on off, Warner presses forward and blocks it into the deck. 12 runs off the over now.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Warner defends it to mid off on the front foot.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! This is very impressive from Warner. Short, on off. Warner pulls it through square leg for a boundary this time.
SIX! BANG! David Warner gets into his 80s with this one. It is full, on off. Warner gets down on one knee and slogs it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Fuller, on the pads, Maxwell flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short, on the pads, Warner pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Good comeback by Raza. He ends the over with three dots on the trot. It is tossed up, full and on off. Maxwell pushes it back to the bowler.
Loops it up, around off. Maxwell strokes it to cover.
Fuller, on off. Maxwell drives it to covers. The fielder does really well to stop the ball.
Floated, outside off. Warner guides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Fraction short, on off. Warner pulls it through mid-wicket. He gets it through the gap and gets a boundary.
Short ball, outside off. Maxwell cuts it through point and rotates the strike.
Sikandar Raza comes into the attack now.
This is angled in, full and on off. Warner stays back and blocks it to backward point.
Fuller, on off, blocked out watchfully.
LEG BYE! This is full, on a length, nips in a touch. Maxwell takes a hit on his thigh pads. It rolls to short third and they collect a leg bye.
Full length, outside off. Maxwell drives it to covers.
Good length, on off, nips in off the deck. Maxwell looks to flick it away but gets hit on his thigh pads.
Length ball, in the channel, Warner steers it to third man for one.
Fuller, outside off. Maxwell drives it to sweeper cover. They take two before the fielder cuts it out.
This is flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, outside off. Warner guides it to third man.
Tossed up, on off, Maxwell sweeps it to short fine leg on a bounce. They take one.
FOUR! Remarkable shot! It is tossed up, full and on off. Maxwell reverse-hits it over point. It goes to the boundary.
Fuller and at the stumps. Maxwell eases it back to the bowler.
Full length, on off. Warner defends it out watchfully. A good over for the hosts. 8 runs off it.

FOUR! Deft touch! David Warner is on a roll here. It is a length ball, outside off, pace up delivery and Warner does well to use this pace in his favour. He stays back and steers it down to third man for a boundary.
This one does not bounce at all! On a length, on off. Warner looks to pull it away but does not get much power on it as his one hand comes off the bat here.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.

Swing and a miss! Evans is over the wicket for the left-hander here. It is a length ball, outside off, angling in. This one though stays low as Warner looks to heave it across the line. He misses it by a mile.
FOUR! SMACKED! David Warner is batting on a different wicket here. It is a short ball, on off. Warner pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Change. Brad Evans (4-1-26-2) is back on now.
Fuller one again, on off, Glenn Maxwell defends it back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Fuller one outside off, Glenn Maxwell looks to drive it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball races past the slips and through third man for a boundary. Lucky boundary!
On off, this is played to sweeper cover for one.
Fuller again, on middle, David Warner flicks it. The fielder makes a good stop diving to his right at short mid-wicket. Dot.
Fuller one this time, Glenn Maxwell flicks it to square leg for one.
On a length and on middle, David Warner tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Fuller and outside off, Glenn Maxwell knocks it through mid of for a boundary. Excellent timing!
Fuller and on middle, Glenn Maxwell eases it to short covers.
On a length and outside off, David Warner slaps it to backward point. The fielder makes a good stop diving to his right. They collect one. Good fielding.
TWO LEG BYES! A length ball, sliding down leg. Warner misses his flick. It goes to fine leg off his pads. They collect two leg byes.
Two in a row! Ngarava goes full, on off. Warner flicks it to mid-wicket.
A dot now! Length ball, on fifth stump. David Warner stays back and defends it to the off side.
Glenn Maxwell comes in at number 7.

OUT! CAUGHT! Half of the side is back in the shed now! Sean Williams does the trick for Zimbabwe this time. Fuller one this time, outside off, this one holds into the deck. Cameron Green drives it but the ball hits the upper part of his bat and carries towards short covers. Ryan Burl adjusts accordingly and takes a sharp catch. Australia surely in a spot of bother.
Commentary.Howout: c Ryan Burl b Sean Williams

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly shorter and on middle, David Warner flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on onn, David Warner sweeps it and gets a top edge. The ball carries to deep square leg where the fielder makes a sliding effort for the ball was way short. They collect two.
Another dot as this is flicked towards the square leg fielder.
Fuller again, outside off, David Warner taps it to the fielder at backward point.
Goes fuller and on off, David Warner defends it to mid on.
A maiden from Richard Ngarava. Fuller and outside off, Cameron Green guides it to the fielder at slips. Good over!
Touch fuller and on off, Cameron Green hits it straight towards the fielder at mid on. Five dots now.
Good length again, on off, Cameron Green blocks it away.
On a length and on middle, this is defended back towards the bowler.
Slightly shorter and on leg, Cameron Green gently flicks it to the fielder at short covers.
Shorter one on middle, Cameron Green fends it to mid off. Dot.

Drinks break! What a start this has been for Zimbabwe. They have torn apart the top-order of Australia but are yet to get rid of David Warner who looks to be settled-in and has also racked up his half-century. Australia know he will be a key for them in this innings. Zimbabwe will be aiming to continue with the same momentum and take a couple more wickets to make it more worse for the hosts. Now, Richard Ngarava (4-0-22-1) comes back into the attack for Zimbabwe. Also, two slips in place now. A very attacking approach from the visitors.
Sean Williams serves a fuller one on middle, Cameron Green flicks it to square leg for one more.
Fuller and on middle, David Warner flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
On off and fuller in length, Cameron Green flicks it to square leg for one.
Fuller again, around middle and leg, Cameron Green blocks it out.
Fuller one this time, David Warner sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, this is defended out.
On a length and outside off, David Warner taps it to backward point for one.

FOUR! Good shot. On a length and outside off, David Warner pulls it through deep square leg for a boundary. Fifty up for David Warner. His 26th in ODI'S and he is holding up the Australian innings together.
On a length and on middle, defended.
Green is off the mark now! It is full, on the pads, Green flicks it to mid-wicket and crosses for a single.
Cameron Green is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Slightly shorter and on middle, Marcus Stoinis looks to block it but misses. A loud shout for caught behind but the finger stays down. Regis Chakabva and Sikandar Raza are pretty confident that it's an outside edge and the skipper goes for a review in no time. The hot spot confirms that there is bat involved and Marcus Stoinis has to trudge back here. Great use of the review by Zimbabwe.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Brad Evans

Commentary.Commentary: Brad Evans bowls a fuller one on middle, Marcus Stoinis blocks it back to the bowler.
Slightly shorter and on off, Marcus Stoinis punches it to covers for one.
Another one outside off, Marcus Stoinis eases it to short covers. Dot.
Fuller and on off, Marcus Stoinis defends it back towards the bowler.
Fuller one this time, David Warner flicks it to square leg for one.
Tossed up, on off, defended back towards the bowler.
Starts with a slightly shorter one, David Warner cuts it to the point fielder.
Change. Time for some spin now. Sean Williams comes into the attack. He replaces Victor Nyauchi.
Fuller one and on off, David Warner guides it towards third man for one.
Outside off this time, David Warner defends it as the ball bounces off the deck. Three dots now.
Another dot as this is again defended to short covers.
On a length and on off, this is defended to short covers.
FOUR! Fuller and outside off, David Warner creams it through extra covers for a boundary.
SIX! Up and over. Fuller one and on middle, David Warner stands firm and lofts it over long off for a biggie. First six of the innings!
A maiden from Victor Nyauchi. This one lands on a length and on off, Marcus Stoinis eases it towards the fielder at covers. Good over!
Outside off again, defended to short covers. Five dots now.
Victor Nyauchi bowls it on a length again, outside off, Marcus Stoinis taps it to the point fielder.
Length ball outside off, Marcus Stoinis leaves it alone to the keeper. Another dot.
On a length again, down the middle, Marcus Stoinis defends it towards the leg side.
Good-length delivery, on middle, this is defended solidly.
FOUR! Fine shot. On a length and on middle, David Warner pulls it through deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Outside off this time, fuller in length, David Warner slices it covers. The ball goes in the air and falls in no man's land. They collect two.
Goes fuller again, on off, Marcus Stoinis flicks it to square leg for one more.
Fuller and outside off, David Warner digs it to backward point for one.
Slightly shorter this time, Marcus Stoinis pulls it to backward square leg for one.
On a length and around off, Marcus Stoinis eases it to short mid-wicket.
Powerplay 1 comes to an end! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the 40th over!
Fuller, on middle and leg, Warner defends it out solidly.
Warner blocks this full-length ball watchfully.
FOUR! David Warner continues to pile up runs for the hosts. Fraction short, outside off. Warner cuts it through the gap at point powerfully and finds the boundary.
A length ball, around off. Warner presses forward and defends it to point.
Full length, on off, Warner hits it to mid on, not in the gap though.

EDGY! It is a full-length ball, angling across the left-hander. David Warner looks to push it away but gets a thick outside edge. It goes way past the sole slip in place. The fielder at third man does well to save the boundary. They take two.
A length ball, wide of off. This one stays low off the deck. Marcus Stoinis has no shot to offer.
Marcus Stoinis is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another man bites the dust for Australia. Brad Evans strikes in his very first over. A bit too careless from Carey. It is a length ball, angling across, outside off. Carey dances down the track and looks to smack it down the ground but only manages to get a thin outside edge. The ball carries to Regis Chakabva behind the sticks who makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Brad Evans

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on fifth stump line. Carey leaves it alone for the keeper.
Full length, around off. Carey gets forward and eases it to mid off.
Swing and a miss! Full length, wide outside off. Alex Carey looks to heave it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller one to start with, Carey drives it to mid off.
Brad Evans comes into the attack.
A length ball, outside off. Warner punches it to point. Alex Carey wanted a single but Warner is quick to send him back.
On a length, wide of off. Warner leaves it alone.

FOUR! EDGY! Some fortune this time for Warner. He is taking the game to the opposition here. It is a length ball, outside off. David Warner stays back and throws the kitchen sink at it. The ball flies over the slip cordon off the outside edge and Warner gets another boundary.
David Warner defends this length ball from his back foot.
FOUR! Down the ground this time! Great placement. He gets his fourth boundary of the game. It is full, around off. Warner gets forward and drives it past the bowler. It races away.
Angling across the left-hander, on a good length. David Warner has no shot to offer.

It is full, sliding down leg. Carey gets struck on his pads as he misses his flick. A stifled appeal from Richard Ngarava but it is surely going down leg. A productive over for Australia as 13 runs come off it.
FOUR! Alex Carey gets off the mark with a boundary. It is full, outside off. Alex Carey leans in and drives it through the gap at covers. Two fielders give it a chase but the ball wins the race.
Just a single this time! A length ball, wide of off. David Warner cuts it to deep point for one.

FOUR! Up and over! David Warner is trying to put some pressure on the bowlers now. It is a short ball, on off. Warner picks up the length early and pulls it over mid-wicket. One bounce and over the ropes.
FOUR! This should ease some pressure. It is a full-length ball, on off. Warner hangs back and flicks it through the gap at square leg. It races away.
Good-length ball, outside off, shaping in a bit late. Warner leaves it alone for the keeper.
BEATEN! What a delivery to end the over! Victor Nyauchi serves it on a length, outside off, Alex Carey looks to chase it but misses. A wicket maiden for Victor Nyauchi now.
Length ball, on off, Carey blocks it out.
Alex Carey walks in.

OUT! LBW! A beauty from Victor Nyauchi. This one looks to be plumb. The umpire agrees and raises his finger. Steven Smith has a long chat with Warner and takes the review. Coming to the delivery, it is a length ball, this one lands outside off and nips back in sharply off the deck. Steven Smith shoulders his arms at it hoping it would got past the off pole instead it comes back in and does the trick. The review later confirms that it is umpire's call on the ball hitting the wickets. Australia don't lose a review but lose their man here. Zimbabwe right on top now.
Full length, outside off. Smith drives it to covers.
Outside off. Smith shuffles across and shoulders his arms at it.
Good length, on top of off. Smith awkwardly blocks it back to the bowler.
A successful over from Richard Ngarava comes to an end! A length ball, on fifth stump. Warner dabs it to point but yells no straightaway for any run here.
Fuller and on off. Warner blocks it to the leg side.
Steven Smith is off the mark! It is full, on the pads, Smith flicks it past mid on and crosses for a single.
Good-length ball, shaping across the right-hander. It also bounces a bit too much. Smith shuffles and shoulders his arms at it.
Steven Smith is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT AT SLIPS! Richard Ngarava gets the better of Finch for the third time in his series. The Australian skipper walks back on just 5. It is a length ball, on off, angling away from the right-hander. Finch shuffles across and looks to defend it out. It takes the outside edge and goes towards the slip cordon. Ryan Burl takes a sharp catch at second slip. An early wicket for Zimbabwe. They will be delighted.
Commentary.Howout: c Ryan Burl b Richard Ngarava

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, outside off. Finch gets on his toes and pushes it to covers.
A maiden this time for Victor Nyauchi! Fuller in length, outside off. Warner leaves it alone for the keeper.
Five does on the trot! It is a length ball, at 119 clicks, outside off. Warner has no shot to offer.
Nyauchi hits the length hard this time, around off. Warner gets it to cover off the outer half.
Make it three! It is full, angled across the left-hander. David Warner gets on his front foot but leaves it alone for the keeper in the end.
Two dots to start with! David Warner punches this length ball to point on his back foot. Not in the gap though.
Length ball, outside off, left alone by Warner.
David Warner looks unhappy with the bottom part of his bat and has asked for a bat change.
Aaron Finch shuffles across and taps this length delivery to point. Another good over from Richard Ngarava, just a boundary off it.
Good-length ball, outside off, angled across. Finch has no shot to offer this time.
FOUR! Exquisite shot! Aaron Finch gets his first boundary of the innings. It is full, outside off. Aaron Finch gets on his front foot and creams it through covers for four.
Good length, around off. Finch hops and eases it to covers.
This one lands on a length, on middle and comes back in. Finch looks to flick it away from inside the crease but gets hit high on his thigh pads.
Full length, wide of off, angled across the right-hander. Finch leaves it alone.

Just a single of the over then. Victor Nyauchi ends his first over on a great note. It is on a length, on off, shaping away from the left-hander. David Warner is caught inside his crease. He looks to defend it out but gets beaten.

A length ball, this time, around off. Warner stays on his back foot and looks to punch it away. It takes the inside edge and hits him on the pads. Warner is quick to keep the ball away from the stumps.
It is angled across, full and outside off. Warner presses forward and defends it to covers.
The Australian skipper gets off the mark now. A length ball, on middle and leg. Finch flicks it to square leg and scampers across for a quick single.
Length ball, on off, with some extra bounce. Finch is taken aback and works it to point.
Nyauchi starts with a dot ball as well! Good length, on fifth stump. Finch shuffles across and shoulders his arms at it.
Victor Nyauchi to bowl with the second new ball.
A great over by Richard Ngarava to start with. Full length, on off. Warner hangs back and blocks it out watchfully. Just 4 runs off the over.
On a length, outside off. Warner defends it to the off side.
FOUR! David Warner gets off the mark in fine manner. It is pitched up, sliding down leg. Warner stays back and glances it down to fine leg for four. Not a lot of swing on offer for the left-hander.
Three dots in a row! Fuller, on off stump. Warner presses forward and defends it back to the bowler.
This one is full, drifting down leg. Warner hangs back and clips it to mid-wicket.
Richard Ngarava starts with a length ball, on top of middle. It bounces a bit too much than anticipated. Warner hangs back and blocks it into the deck.

The game is set to begin. Zimbabwe players stride out to the middle. Followed by Aaron Finch and David Warner who walk out to open for Australia. Richard Ngarava to start with the new ball. Here we go...

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Takudzwanashe Kaitano (In place of Innocent Kaia), Tadiwanashe Marumani, Wesley Madhevere, Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Regis Chakabva (C/ WK), Ryan Burl, Tony Munyonga, Brad Evans, Richard Ngarava, Victor Nyauchi (In for Luke Jongwe).
Australia (Unchanged playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Steven Smith, Alex Carey (WK), Marcus Stoinis, Cameron Green, Glenn Maxwell, Ashton Agar, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the toss and elected to BOWL first.

Chakabva will be expecting his side to step up and rise to this occasion. Wesley Madhevere did well in the first ODI and he will be hoping to do the same now. The side will be hoping for some good performance from Sikandar Raza as well. Will the visitors bounce back? Or will the hosts continue to dominate them? We shall find out together. Toss and team news are around the corner.
